additional_info.subject: ID0479315-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/17] CP1 Charging Sessions Stop Prematurely CRM:03275000080
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0479315
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / P0 312567479/17
Charger ID / Serial No.:
RFhsW1
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason: CP1 Charging Sessions Stop Prematurely .
Please measure on-site and confirm the values by measuring directly on the cables coming from the CCS. If you see the same value, then the CCS is faulty and needs replacement. Otherwise, please measure the 1kOhm until you reach the KF12/13.
P1 to P2 and N1 to N2
If you get 1kOhm until the StateMonitor, please try replacing the grey connector with a spare one (they have some connectors on the EcoGs that are not used at all)
Or replace the StateMonitor
I recommend you to take spare CCS and StateMonitor
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Anass Mezzaoui
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: 0479315 - ID0479315-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P0 312567479/17] CP1 Charging Sessions Stop Prematurely CRM:02441000212
additional_info.body:
Bonjour,
Après analyse de cette borne, il apparaît qu’elle est pleinement fonctionnelle. Aucun message d’erreur n’a été détecté.
L’examen des logs ainsi que des sessions de charge montre que la borne a délivré plus de 150 kW lors de plusieurs sessions enregistrées. Une session de charge est d’ailleurs actuellement en cours.
Nous vous invitons à rouvrir un ticket si l’incident se reproduit. Le cas échéant, merci de bien vouloir nous communiquer la date, l’heure ainsi que la nature précise du dysfonctionnement constaté.
Ce ticket sera donc clôturé à ce stade.
Cordialement,
Ramdane Chergui

additional_info.subject: RE: A new case manager was assigned to 0479315 CRM:00225342141
additional_info.body:
Hello Joao,
I hope this message finds you well.
Could you please take a look at this ticket ? The charging station appears to be operational, and no error flags are being reported. Upon reviewing the logs, I can confirm that charging sessions have taken place. For example, a session delivering 150 kW was recorded on 20/02 at 09:07.
However, the client reports that the sessions did not last more than three minutes before stopping without any apparent reason, as shown in the attached picture.
Could you please investigate this issue?
Kind regards,
Ramdane Chergui
